sections.title: Afternoon/Evening Shift (14:30 – 22:30)

Ops phone on charge; 0 response calls to report, no further issues.
Ops phone still on charge; 0 response calls to report, no further issues.
Ops phone still on charge; 0 response calls to report, no further issues. Standing by.

Welfare checks completed on Nike Queen Street, Cotton On Queen Street, Footlocker Queen Street, Unichem Queen Street and McDonald's Queen Street; all clear, checked up on staff, no issues to report.
Full sweep on Darby Street completed; welfare check on Recycle Boutique, no issues to report.
Full sweep Elliott Street; thorough welfare check on Elliotstables, no issues to report. Standing by.
Full sweep Wellesley Street West, all clear. Standing by monitoring foot traffic and public activity.
Heading over to Aotea Square via Albert Street.
Albert Street, Mayoral Dr and Myers Street sweep completed.

sections.title: Night Shift (22:30 – 06:30)
items: Equipment received: 5 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, Ops Phone, 2 x Bodycam, 2 x Radio.
Arrived at Wyndham Street; route all clear. Moving along.
Arrived at Shortland Street; conducting a sweep as the path ahead appears to have little to no traffic.
Shortland Street all clear; a few civilians using the route, no issues. Continuing down to Commercial Bay for usual checkpoints.
Sweep concluded; welfare check on McDonald's.
Welfare check all done. Stood by shortly to show presence given the volume of civilians in the restaurant and around T4 Square. Moving down Customs Street East to cut through Fort Lane.
Fort Lane all clear. Heading towards High Street.
Commencing sweep up High Street; checking on avenues along the way.
Freyberg Square all clear; area isn't busy at this hour. Vagrants sleeping, no further comments. Moving along.
Victoria Street East all clear; little to no traffic in the area. Moving up Lorne Street.
Lorne Street clear; conducting a sweep at Central City Library since we're en route.
Arrived at Central City Library; vagrants sleeping in the area, no issues causing concern. Cutting through Rutland Street heading towards Aotea Square.
Arrived at Aotea Square; conducting sweep of the area.
Sweep concluded; area all clear. Moving back down Queen Street towards Queen Street McDonald's.

Arrived at Queen Street McDonald's; staff expressed concern regarding a group of teens loitering outside the restaurant. On arrival the teens were not in the area; we will stand by in case they return.

Standby concluded; no sign of the teens. Staff advised to call us if they return. Received a call from Queen Street McDonald's regarding a male sleeping on the chair and a female in the bathroom; heading down to resolve the two individuals.
Arrived at Queen Street Maccas; carrying out removals.
Successfully removed both individuals; staff welfare all well. Heading to office to commence floor checks.
Floor checks completed. Charging ops phone, currently on 11%.
Phone charged sufficiently to continue patrols. Heading up Victoria Street West.
Arrived at Albert Street; conducting sweep.
Skymart welfare check; Albert Street all clear. Heading up towards Federal Street.
77 Convenience Store welfare check; Federal Street sweep conducted, no issues. Heading back down Wellesley Street towards Elliott Street.
Elliott Street all clear; Atrium secured. Heading through Darby Street.
Darby Street all clear, no issues. Heading down Queen Street.
Durham Street West all clear. Moving along.
Arrived at Commercial Bay for another sweep.

Commercial Bay all clear; McDonald's Britomart welfare check conducted. Reports of a vagrant male sleeping in store but compliant when asked to leave. No further comments from staff. Standing by shortly to show presence and awaiting response calls before continuing.
Britomart McDonald's all clear. Continuing towards Fort Lane and Fort Street.
Fort Lane and Fort Street all clear; area quieter than before. Moving along.
Shortland Street all clear. Continuing up High Street.
Freyberg Square all clear; again just vagrants sleeping in the area, no cause for concern. Moving along.
Lorne Street all clear. Heading towards Central City Library.
Central City Library all clear; a few vagrants sleeping in the area are starting to pack up, no cause for concern. Moving on.
Conducting a sweep around Aotea Square.
Aotea Square all clear; no issues to report at this hour. Heading to Queen Street McDonald's for another welfare check.
Queen Street McDonald's all clear; staff relayed the two previous individuals have not returned since prior intervention. Standing by shortly before heading to office for handover with morning shift.
Handover with morning team completed. Night shift concluded.
